title: Sordland/Turn03/EnT_Budget
description: Symon Holl arranges a cabinet meeting for the government budget. Election promises are laid out and and a debate over what to invest where is made. Each minister strongly makes their position clear. The player is forced to make a balancing act between following election promises, keeping the cabinet satisfied and making a balanced budget. This is a major economic turning point with political outcomes.
